items.title: Tony Marino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 25, 2025
items.q: So here I’d get to play with John Coates and my friend Nelson Hill on saxophone

ctx.x: Don’t play in four or something like that.

Like okay you can go into four now, when the water is up to your chin. But that was it. You stayed in two and when he gave me the four fingers, that was okay to swing. But yeah, it was all about dance music you know. And it got boring for a young musician. I wanted to – I wanted to do, I was listening to what everybody else I was listening to was doing as well you know. But when we played in the Poconos our little Garden of Eden was to run to the Deer Head Inn after the gigs. And there was a great piano player…
Oh yes. He’s an author too as well I think.
